blocks.text: User guide

Use authorized data and test destinations. Start with the repository's reviewed synthetic fixtures.

SourceSnapshot creates GUID directories under a per-user-derived temporary root or explicitly supplied StorageRoot, with source.bin and an exclusive lease. Decoded spools use owned delete-on-close files. Search borrows originals; SQL and other completed outputs can own independent captures/result journals. These files may contain sensitive plaintext, regardless of whether a persistent patient database exists. Close/replacement drains readers/work before best-effort cleanup; old lease-free abandoned storage can be removed on a later bounded cleanup pass.
